변경 이유: 검토 지적대로 `_ttc_stop_backup` 을 진단 2·4단계에 맞췄습니다. (1) skip 구간에서 트리거를 지우던 줄을 없애, `_raw_ttc_stop` 이 pause 를 주면 언제나 `pause_until = max(pause_until, t + pause)` 가 됩니다. (2) `_RTS_MAX_T` 강제 해제를 빼고, 해제는 `t >= pause_until` 일 때만 `rts_on` 을 끄는 방식으로 바꿨습니다. 이제 `pause_until` 을 -1 로 지우지 않으므로 `_rear_backup` 의 `rb_hold` 타이머가 보존됩니다. 남는 위험은 지도에 없는 정지 물체가 전방 회랑에 있을 때 `ttc_a` 가 되풀이되어 정지·재출발이 반복되고 시간 예산을 더 쓸 수 있다는 점이며, 백업 명령, `_guard`, 호출 위치는 바꾸지 않았습니다.

```python
def _ttc_stop_backup(st, t, pose, M):
    """Raw-TTC early stop with immediate back-up (diagnosis chosen candidate 1).
    1) pause = _raw_ttc_stop(...) every cycle; whenever it is not None -> st["pause_until"] = max(st["pause_until"],
    t + pause) (always, no skip window).  2) nearest unmapped point via _px_dist; 3) on the trigger (and later while
    that point is itself closing or is within _PX_BACK_D) _px_backup_cmd(st, pose, M, near) gives a back-up speed
    away from it (lidar strip, swept body, static map and mover margin checked there); it is held _PX_BACK_T s and
    every back-up command passes _guard.  4) otherwise stay stopped (0, 0) while t < pause_until.  5) only when
    t >= pause_until is the flag (rts_on) cleared - pause_until itself is left untouched so other layers' timers
    (e.g. _rear_backup's rb_hold) survive - and None is returned so the existing VO / predictive-speed pipeline
    runs unchanged.  Returns (v, w) while active, else None."""
    pause = _raw_ttc_stop(st, t, pose)
    cm, d, near = _rts_closing(st, pose)
    new = False
    if pause is not None:
        if not st["rts_on"]:
            st["rts_t0"] = t
            new = True
        st["rts_on"] = True
        st["pause_until"] = max(st["pause_until"], t + pause)
    if not st["rts_on"]:
        return None

    # pause over: resume the normal pipeline (only the flag is cleared)
    if t >= st["pause_until"]:
        st["rts_on"] = False
        return None

    P = st["raw"]
    # back-up in progress (cancelled if its lidar strip / swept body gets blocked)
    if st["rts_back_until"] > t:
        v = st["rts_back_v"]
        if _lidar_clear(P, v, 0.4) and _sweep_clear(P, v, 0.0, 0.3):
            return _guard(st, pose, M, v, 0.0)
        st["rts_back_until"] = -1.0

    # immediate back-up on the trigger, and again while the point keeps coming at us / is very close
    if near is not None and (new or cm or d < _PX_BACK_D):
        v = _px_backup_cmd(st, pose, M, near)
        if v is not None:
            st["rts_back_v"] = v
            st["rts_back_until"] = t + _PX_BACK_T
            st["pause_until"] = max(st["pause_until"], t + _PX_BACK_T + 0.3)
            return _guard(st, pose, M, v, 0.0)

    return 0.0, 0.0
```
